training_configuration.features: Three centered frozen Apertus next-token option logits; no hidden-state cache

configuration.gpu: CPU head; source encoding on RTX 4090
configuration.notes: Reuses actual GPU logits; no new rental cost. Raw trained classifier probabilities, not independently calibrated. Training sample is small and concentrated in two connected groups; grouped calibration was not performed. Latency sums measured source encoding and per-row CPU head inference, not a live integrated service. Official class semantics/full-booklet scope unverified; no final test.
